name: SuperCDMS
summary: SuperCDMS continues the CDMS cryogenic semiconductor programme. After Soudan, low-threshold Ge/Si arrays are being deployed at SNOLAB in Canada to target light dark matter.
detection_principle: The iZIP mode combines ionization and phonons for background discrimination. High-voltage operation amplifies phonons through the Neganov–Trofimov–Luke effect, lowering the detectable ionization energy.

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
